scenes.say: Being good isn't enough. Good players go broke all the time.
Bankroll management is surviving the bad runs long enough for your edge to show up.
Three groups, all with a real edge: win {a_p}. Only the bankroll differs: {a_start}, {b_start}, {c_start} bets.
Skill decides how much you win. Bankroll decides whether you're still there to win it.

takeaway: Skill decides how much you win. Bankroll decides whether you're still there to win it.
